```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
```
```{r}
merged<-read.csv('london_final.csv')
```

```{r}
# 1. Price outliers — anything suspiciously low or high?
merged %>%
  summarise(
    under_10k   = sum(price < 10000, na.rm = TRUE),
    under_50k   = sum(price < 50000, na.rm = TRUE),
    over_5m     = sum(price > 5000000, na.rm = TRUE),
    over_10m    = sum(price > 10000000, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
# 2. Check numeric variables for nonsensical values
merged %>%
  summarise(
    neg_floor_area     = sum(total_floor_area <= 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    zero_rooms         = sum(number_habitable_rooms == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    neg_heating_cost   = sum(heating_cost_current < 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    neg_efficiency     = sum(current_energy_efficiency <= 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
# 3. Check categorical variables
merged %>% count(property_type) %>% arrange(desc(n))
merged %>% count(current_energy_rating) %>% arrange(current_energy_rating)
merged %>% count(old_new) %>% arrange(desc(n))
merged %>% count(duration) %>% arrange(desc(n))
```

```{r}
# 4. Overall missing value summary
merged %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~sum(is.na(.)))) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "variable", values_to = "missing") %>%
  filter(missing > 0) %>%
  arrange(desc(missing))
```

```{r}
merged_clean <- merged %>%
  
  # ── 1. DROP PRICE OUTLIERS ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  filter(price >= 10000) %>%
  
  # ── 2. DROP NEGATIVE/ZERO FLOOR AREA ─────────────────────────────────────
  filter(is.na(total_floor_area) | total_floor_area > 0) %>%
  
  # ── 3. FIX NEGATIVE ENERGY COSTS → NA ────────────────────────────────────
  mutate(
    heating_cost_current   = ifelse(heating_cost_current < 0,   NA, heating_cost_current),
    heating_cost_potential = ifelse(heating_cost_potential < 0, NA, heating_cost_potential),
    hot_water_cost_current = ifelse(hot_water_cost_current < 0, NA, hot_water_cost_current),
    lighting_cost_current  = ifelse(lighting_cost_current < 0,  NA, lighting_cost_current)
  ) %>%
  
  # ── 4. DROP COLUMNS TOO SPARSE OR REDUNDANT FOR MODELLING ────────────────
  select(
    -flat_storey_count,   # 97% missing — unusable
    -property_type_epc,   # redundant with property_type from PPD
    -saon_clean,          # join key only
    -paon_clean,          # join key only
    -paon,                # raw address — not needed for modelling
    -saon,                # raw address — not needed for modelling
    -lmk_key,             # EPC identifier — not needed for modelling
    -lodgement_date       # EPC date — not needed for modelling
  ) %>%

  # ── 5. FIX PROPERTY TYPE — PPD CODES TO LABELS ────────────────────────────
  mutate(
    property_type = case_when(
      property_type == "D" ~ "Detached",
      property_type == "S" ~ "Semi-Detached",
      property_type == "T" ~ "Terraced",
      property_type == "F" ~ "Flat",
      property_type == "O" ~ "Other",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    old_new = case_when(
      old_new == "Y" ~ "New",
      old_new == "N" ~ "Established",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    duration = case_when(
      duration == "F" ~ "Freehold",
      duration == "L" ~ "Leasehold",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%

  # ── 6. CONVERT ENERGY RATING TO ORDERED FACTOR ───────────────────────────
  mutate(
    current_energy_rating = factor(
      current_energy_rating,
      levels = c("G", "F", "E", "D", "C", "B", "A"),
      ordered = TRUE
    )
  )

# ── 7. CHECK ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
cat("Rows:", nrow(merged_clean), "\n")
cat("Columns:", ncol(merged_clean), "\n")

# Final missing value check
merged_clean %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~sum(is.na(.)))) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "variable", values_to = "missing") %>%
  filter(missing > 0) %>%
  arrange(desc(missing))
```

```{r}
merged_clean <- merged_clean %>%
  # Drop unmatched EPC rows
  filter(!is.na(current_energy_rating)) %>%
  # Drop remaining rows with missing coordinates
  filter(!is.na(lat), !is.na(long), !is.na(dist_to_tube_km)) %>%
  # Drop rows with missing postcode or street
  filter(!is.na(postcode), !is.na(street))

cat("Final dataset rows:", nrow(merged_clean), "\n")
cat("Final dataset cols:", ncol(merged_clean), "\n")
```

```{r}
merged_clean <- merged_clean %>%
  # Fix floor area cap
  mutate(total_floor_area = ifelse(total_floor_area > 500, NA, total_floor_area)) %>%
  # Fix impossible EPC efficiency
  mutate(
    current_energy_efficiency   = ifelse(current_energy_efficiency > 100, NA, current_energy_efficiency),
    potential_energy_efficiency = ifelse(potential_energy_efficiency > 100, NA, potential_energy_efficiency)
  ) %>%
  # Fix impossible room counts
  mutate(number_habitable_rooms = ifelse(number_habitable_rooms > 20, NA, number_habitable_rooms)) %>%
  # Fix built_form junk values
  mutate(built_form = ifelse(built_form %in% c("NO DATA!", "Not Recorded"), NA, built_form))

# Quick verify
merged_clean %>%
  summarise(
    max_floor_area  = max(total_floor_area, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_efficiency  = max(current_energy_efficiency, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_rooms       = max(number_habitable_rooms, na.rm = TRUE),
    bad_built_form  = sum(built_form %in% c("NO DATA!", "Not Recorded"), na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
merged_clean <- merged_clean %>%

  # ── 1. floor_level: houses → "Ground", flats → mode ──────────────────────
  mutate(
    floor_level = case_when(
      property_type != "Flat" ~ "Ground",
      is.na(floor_level) & property_type == "Flat" ~ "Unknown",
      TRUE ~ floor_level
    )
  ) %>%

  # ── 2. total_floor_area: median by property type ──────────────────────────
  group_by(property_type) %>%
  mutate(
    total_floor_area = ifelse(
      is.na(total_floor_area),
      median(total_floor_area, na.rm = TRUE),
      total_floor_area
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%

  # ── 3. construction_age_band: mode by property type ───────────────────────
  group_by(property_type) %>%
  mutate(
    construction_age_band = ifelse(
      is.na(construction_age_band),
      names(sort(table(construction_age_band), decreasing = TRUE))[1],
      construction_age_band
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%

  # ── 4. built_form: mode by property type ─────────────────────────────────
  group_by(property_type) %>%
  mutate(
    built_form = ifelse(
      is.na(built_form),
      names(sort(table(built_form), decreasing = TRUE))[1],
      built_form
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%

  # ── 5. main_fuel: mode overall ────────────────────────────────────────────
  mutate(
    main_fuel = ifelse(
      is.na(main_fuel),
      names(sort(table(main_fuel), decreasing = TRUE))[1],
      main_fuel
    )
  ) %>%

  # ── 6. mains_gas_flag: derive from main_fuel ─────────────────────────────
  mutate(
    mains_gas_flag = case_when(
      !is.na(mains_gas_flag) ~ mains_gas_flag,
      main_fuel == "mains gas (not community)" ~ "Y",
      TRUE ~ "N"
    )
  ) %>%

  # ── 7. energy costs: median by property type ──────────────────────────────
  group_by(property_type) %>%
  mutate(
    heating_cost_current   = ifelse(is.na(heating_cost_current),   median(heating_cost_current,   na.rm = TRUE), heating_cost_current),
    heating_cost_potential = ifelse(is.na(heating_cost_potential), median(heating_cost_potential, na.rm = TRUE), heating_cost_potential),
    hot_water_cost_current = ifelse(is.na(hot_water_cost_current), median(hot_water_cost_current, na.rm = TRUE), hot_water_cost_current),
    lighting_cost_current  = ifelse(is.na(lighting_cost_current),  median(lighting_cost_current,  na.rm = TRUE), lighting_cost_current)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%

  # ── 8. EPC descriptions: "Unknown" for small missingness ──────────────────
  mutate(
    walls_description   = ifelse(is.na(walls_description),   "Unknown", walls_description),
    roof_description    = ifelse(is.na(roof_description),    "Unknown", roof_description),
    windows_description = ifelse(is.na(windows_description), "Unknown", windows_description),
    mainheat_description = ifelse(is.na(mainheat_description), "Unknown", mainheat_description)
  ) %>%

  # ── 9. current/potential energy efficiency: median by rating ──────────────
  group_by(current_energy_rating) %>%
  mutate(
    current_energy_efficiency   = ifelse(is.na(current_energy_efficiency),   median(current_energy_efficiency,   na.rm = TRUE), current_energy_efficiency),
    potential_energy_efficiency = ifelse(is.na(potential_energy_efficiency), median(potential_energy_efficiency, na.rm = TRUE), potential_energy_efficiency)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# ── 10. number_habitable_rooms and remaining: leave as NA ─────────────────
# Will use complete-case or model-based handling at modelling stage

# Check
merged_clean %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~sum(is.na(.)))) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "variable", values_to = "missing") %>%
  filter(missing > 0) %>%
  mutate(pct = round(missing / nrow(merged_clean) * 100, 1)) %>%
  arrange(desc(missing))
```

```{r}
# Is there correlation between rooms and floor area?
cor(merged_clean$number_habitable_rooms, 
    merged_clean$total_floor_area, 
    use = "complete.obs")
```

```{r}
# Build a simple linear model to predict rooms from floor area + property type
rooms_model <- lm(
  number_habitable_rooms ~ total_floor_area + property_type,
  data = merged_clean %>% filter(!is.na(number_habitable_rooms))
)

summary(rooms_model)

# Impute missing rooms using the model
merged_clean <- merged_clean %>%
  mutate(
    number_habitable_rooms = ifelse(
      is.na(number_habitable_rooms),
      round(predict(rooms_model, newdata = .)),
      number_habitable_rooms
    ),
    # Cap at sensible range just in case model predicts extreme values
    number_habitable_rooms = pmax(1, pmin(number_habitable_rooms, 20))
  )

# Verify no missing remain
cat("Missing rooms after imputation:", sum(is.na(merged_clean$number_habitable_rooms)), "\n")

# Check distribution looks sensible
merged_clean %>%
  group_by(property_type) %>%
  summarise(
    min    = min(number_habitable_rooms),
    median = median(number_habitable_rooms),
    mean   = round(mean(number_habitable_rooms), 1),
    max    = max(number_habitable_rooms)
  )
```

```{r}
table(data$construction_age_band)
```
```{r}
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    construction_age_band = case_when(
      # ── Junk/invalid → NA ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
      construction_age_band %in% c("INVALID!", "NO DATA!") ~ NA_character_,
      
      # ── Future years (impossible) → NA ────────────────────────────────────
      construction_age_band %in% c("2026", "2035", "2042") ~ NA_character_,
      
      # ── Raw years → band them ─────────────────────────────────────────────
      construction_age_band %in% c("1850", "1890", "1900", "1904", "1911") ~ "Before 1919",
      construction_age_band %in% c("1920", "1925") ~ "1919-1929",
      construction_age_band %in% c("1930", "1950") ~ "1930-1949",
      construction_age_band %in% c("1960") ~ "1950-1966",
      construction_age_band %in% c("1985") ~ "1983-1990",
      construction_age_band %in% c("2000") ~ "1996-2002",
      construction_age_band %in% c("2010", "2012", "2013", "2014", 
                                    "2015", "2016", "2017") ~ "2007-2011",
      construction_age_band %in% c("2018", "2019", "2020", 
                                    "2021", "2022", "2023",
                                    "2024", "2025") ~ "2012 onwards",
      
      # ── Standardise existing bands to consistent labels ───────────────────
      str_detect(construction_age_band, "before 1900") ~ "Before 1919",
      str_detect(construction_age_band, "1900-1929")   ~ "1919-1929",
      str_detect(construction_age_band, "1930-1949")   ~ "1930-1949",
      str_detect(construction_age_band, "1950-1966")   ~ "1950-1966",
      str_detect(construction_age_band, "1967-1975")   ~ "1967-1975",
      str_detect(construction_age_band, "1976-1982")   ~ "1976-1982",
      str_detect(construction_age_band, "1983-1990")   ~ "1983-1990",
      str_detect(construction_age_band, "1991-1995")   ~ "1991-1995",
      str_detect(construction_age_band, "1996-2002")   ~ "1996-2002",
      str_detect(construction_age_band, "2003-2006")   ~ "2003-2006",
      str_detect(construction_age_band, "2007-2011|2007 onwards") ~ "2007-2011",
      str_detect(construction_age_band, "2012-2021|2012 onwards") ~ "2012 onwards",
      str_detect(construction_age_band, "2022 onwards") ~ "2012 onwards",
      
      TRUE ~ construction_age_band
    )
  ) %>%
  # Impute remaining NAs with mode by property type
  group_by(property_type) %>%
  mutate(
    construction_age_band = ifelse(
      is.na(construction_age_band),
      names(sort(table(construction_age_band), decreasing = TRUE))[1],
      construction_age_band
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Verify
data %>%
  count(construction_age_band) %>%
  mutate(pct = round(n/sum(n)*100,1)) %>%
  arrange(construction_age_band)
```

```{r}
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    floor_level_clean = case_when(
      # ── Basement/Below ground ─────────────────────────────────────────────
      floor_level %in% c("-1", "Basement") ~ "Basement",
      
      # ── Ground floor ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      floor_level %in% c("0", "00", "Ground", "ground floor") ~ "Ground",
      
      # ── Mid floors (1-3) ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
      floor_level %in% c("01", "1", "1st", "mid floor") ~ "Floor 1-3",
      floor_level %in% c("02", "2", "2nd") ~ "Floor 1-3",
      floor_level %in% c("03", "3", "3rd") ~ "Floor 1-3",
      
      # ── Mid-high floors (4-6) ─────────────────────────────────────────────
      floor_level %in% c("04", "4th", "05", "5th", "06", "6th") ~ "Floor 4-6",
      
      # ── High floors (7-9) ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
      floor_level %in% c("07", "7th", "08", "8th", "09", "9th") ~ "Floor 7-9",
      
      # ── Very high floors (10+) ────────────────────────────────────────────
      floor_level %in% c("10", "10th", "11", "11th", "12", "12th",
                          "13", "13th", "14", "14th", "15", "15th",
                          "16", "16th", "17", "17th", "18", "18th",
                          "19", "19th", "20", "20+", "20th",
                          "21st or above", "top floor") ~ "Floor 10+",
      
      # ── Junk → Unknown ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      floor_level %in% c("NO DATA!", "NODATA!", "Unknown") ~ "Unknown",
      
      # ── Already imputed as Ground for houses ──────────────────────────────
      floor_level == "Ground" ~ "Ground",
      
      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-floor_level) %>%
  rename(floor_level = floor_level_clean)

# Verify
data %>%
  count(floor_level) %>%
  mutate(pct = round(n/sum(n)*100,1)) %>%
  arrange(floor_level)
```

```{r}
data <- data %>%
  # Fix price floor
  filter(price >= 50000) %>%
  # Fix zero and extreme energy costs
  mutate(
    heating_cost_current   = ifelse(heating_cost_current == 0,   NA, heating_cost_current),
    hot_water_cost_current = ifelse(hot_water_cost_current == 0, NA, hot_water_cost_current),
    lighting_cost_current  = ifelse(lighting_cost_current == 0,  NA, lighting_cost_current),
    heating_cost_potential = ifelse(heating_cost_potential == 0, NA, heating_cost_potential)
  ) %>%
  # Cap extreme heating costs at 99th percentile
  mutate(
    p99_heat = quantile(heating_cost_current, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE),
    heating_cost_current = ifelse(heating_cost_current > p99_heat, p99_heat, heating_cost_current)
  ) %>%
  select(-p99_heat) %>%
  # Re-impute the new NAs with median by property type
  group_by(property_type) %>%
  mutate(
    heating_cost_current   = ifelse(is.na(heating_cost_current),   median(heating_cost_current,   na.rm = TRUE), heating_cost_current),
    hot_water_cost_current = ifelse(is.na(hot_water_cost_current), median(hot_water_cost_current, na.rm = TRUE), hot_water_cost_current),
    lighting_cost_current  = ifelse(is.na(lighting_cost_current),  median(lighting_cost_current,  na.rm = TRUE), lighting_cost_current),
    heating_cost_potential = ifelse(is.na(heating_cost_potential), median(heating_cost_potential, na.rm = TRUE), heating_cost_potential)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Quick verify
cat("Rows:", nrow(data), "\n")
cat("Missing values:", sum(is.na(data)), "\n")
data %>%
  summarise(
    min_price       = min(price),
    min_heat_cost   = min(heating_cost_current),
    max_heat_cost   = max(heating_cost_current),
    min_hotwater    = min(hot_water_cost_current),
    min_lighting    = min(lighting_cost_current)
  )
```

```{r}
data <- data %>%

    heating_cost_current   = ifelse(heating_cost_current < 50,   NA, heating_cost_current),
    heating_cost_potential = ifelse(heating_cost_potential < 50,  NA, heating_cost_potential),
    hot_water_cost_current = ifelse(hot_water_cost_current < 20,  NA, hot_water_cost_current),
    lighting_cost_current  = ifelse(lighting_cost_current < 10,   NA, lighting_cost_current)

  mutate(

    heating_cost_potential = ifelse(is.na(heating_cost_potential), median(heating_cost_potential, na.rm = TRUE), heating_cost_potential),
    hot_water_cost_current = ifelse(is.na(hot_water_cost_current), median(hot_water_cost_current, na.rm = TRUE), hot_water_cost_current),
    lighting_cost_current  = ifelse(is.na(lighting_cost_current),  median(lighting_cost_current,  na.rm = TRUE), lighting_cost_current)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Verify
```
